# Swoosh Lines

**Cover › Stroke** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–90)

Waves of rounded diagonal ribbons sweep across, the last wave in the new background colour, then sweep on out to show the new scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/swoosh-lines@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/swoosh-lines@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Energetic social and promo edits
- Sports and music
- Brand moments

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import swooshLines from './transitions/04-cover/stroke/swoosh-lines';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(swooshLines, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `colors` | colors | `["#111111","#FF4F1A"]` |  | One colour per wave; the last wave covers the frame (use the incoming background colour). |
| `ribbons` | integer | `7` | 3–16 | Ribbons per wave. |
| `angle` | number | `-28` | -60–60 | Ribbon angle in degrees. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
